avis.titre: SUN RISE Mineral Sunscreen Stick Broad Spectrum SPF 40
avis.texte: I recently tried the Sun Rise Mineral Sunscreen Stick and I've been really impressed so far! The stick format makes it super easy to apply, especially when I'm on the go or need a quick reapplication during the day. It glides on smoothly without tugging on my skin and blends in better than I expected for a mineral sunscreen. I love how lightweight it feels—no heavy or greasy residue—and it layers well over my skincare and makeup. It also gives my skin a nice natural glow without looking shiny. I've been using it on my face, especially around my nose and cheeks, and it hasn't clogged my pores or caused any irritation. The packaging is super convenient to throw in my bag, which makes it perfect for busy days, workouts, or being outside. Overall, it's a great everyday SPF option, especially if you want something mess-free and easy to reapply. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a portable mineral sunscreen that actually feels good on your skin!
Unlike many mineral sunscreens that feel like paste, this has a "milkier" consistency. It spreads easily and feels more like a moisturizer than a traditional sunblock.
